description:
`applyHashlineEdits` (packages/pi-hashline-readmap/src/hashline.ts, around line 820) counts changed lines positionally, so any mid-file `insert_after` counts every later line as changed and warns, e.g. "Edit changed 697 lines across 9 operations — verify no unintended reformatting" on a +12/-3 edit.

Evidence (evals/hashline/RESULTS.md): it fired 11 times per t5 session and 14-15 per t6 session, every one a false positive; it was followed by a re-read twice. Decision (Bryan, 2026-11-16): drop it; it is a holdover.

Done: the warning and its counting loop are gone, no test depends on it, and an `insert_after` mid-file returns no warning. Gates clean.
title: hashline: drop the 'verify no unintended reformatting' edit warning
